description: This file contains the implementation of the Cart class within the OpenCart system. It manages shopping cart operations such as adding products, retrieving cart products, applying discounts, handling options, and updating cart data. The class interacts with the database and other system components like customer, session, and configuration objects.

classes.name: Cart
classes.description: Represents a shopping cart, handling product management, options, discounts, and total calculation within the OpenCart ecommerce platform.

classes.name: Cart
classes.description: Represents a shopping cart, handling product management, options, discounts, totals, and subscriptions within the OpenCart ecommerce platform.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Cart object with dependencies from the registry, sets up database connection, configuration, customer, session, and tax objects, and cleans up expired cart entries.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves the list of products currently in the cart, including handling of options, variants, discounts, and special prices.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves the list of products currently in the cart, including handling of options, variants, discounts, special prices, reward points, downloads, stock validation, and subscription data.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a product to the cart with specified options, subscription plan, override flag, and price. It checks for existing entries and updates quantity or inserts new entries accordingly. Clears and repopulates the cart data after operation.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a cart item identified by cart ID, clears previous cart data, and repopulates the cart products.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a cart item exists by cart ID.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a cart item by cart ID and updates the internal data accordingly.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all cart data, deleting all cart entries associated with the current session, customer, and API ID, and resets internal data.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all subscription plans associated with products currently in the cart.

methods.name: getWeight
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total weight of products in the cart, taking into account weight conversion.

methods.name: getSubTotal
methods.description: Calculates and returns the subtotal price of all products in the cart.

methods.name: getTaxes
methods.description: Computes and returns applicable tax amounts for each tax rate based on product prices and tax classes.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total price including taxes for all products in the cart.

methods.name: countProducts
methods.description: Counts and returns the total quantity of all products in the cart.

methods.name: hasProducts
methods.description: Returns true if the cart has any products, false otherwise.

methods.name: hasSubscription
methods.description: Returns true if any product in the cart has a subscription plan associated.

methods.name: hasStock
methods.description: Checks if all products are in stock based on their quantities and stock management settings.

methods.name: hasDownload
methods.description: Checks if any products in the cart have downloadable content.

methods.name: hasShipping
methods.description: Checks if any products in the cart require shipping.
